market_name: Will 7 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether front-end rate futures (SOFR/Fed funds futures) and 2y yields are falling in tandem; confirm move isn't noise.
time_plan.1h: Compare TLT move to any macro headline (jobs, CPI, geopolitical shock) that would already be public.
time_plan.2h: Assess whether the dovish repricing is holding or fading; watch curve steepening vs bull-flattening.
time_plan.6h: Re-evaluate against equity behavior — if equities also selling off hard, the driver is risk-off/recession, reinforcing bond bid.
time_plan.12h: Confirm whether TLT closed higher and whether rate-cut odds across other maturities repriced consistently.

predictions.reasoning: A market pricing 7 Fed cuts in 2026 reflects an extremely dovish path, plausibly tied to recession or a crisis (note the odd 'military_conflict' topic tag) requiring emergency easing. A sharp rise in this probability implies falling policy-rate expectations, which pushes bond prices up. TLT is the most liquid duration proxy and rallies as the expected rate path drops.

predictions.tradable_instrument_name: Invesco DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check DXY and EURUSD alongside rate futures to see if dollar is weakening or catching a haven bid.
time_plan.1h: Determine whether the driver is growth-scare (dollar could firm) vs pure dovish repricing (dollar softens).
time_plan.2h: Watch gold as a cross-check on real-rate/dollar dynamics.
time_plan.6h: Reassess dollar trend and whether risk sentiment dominates over rate differentials.
time_plan.12h: Confirm UUP close and whether FX move was consistent with the rate repricing thesis.

predictions.reasoning: Aggressive Fed easing expectations narrow US rate differentials, typically weakening the dollar. If the 7-cut probability jumps, DXY-linked UUP would tend to soften. However this is weaker/ambiguous: a crisis-driven dovish scenario often triggers safe-haven dollar buying, so direction is uncertain.

evidence_used: Market question asks about 7 Fed cuts in 2026, an unusually dovish/extreme easing scenario
Resolution tied to FOMC statements and target fed funds rate changes
Inclusion of emergency inter-meeting cuts suggests crisis-contingent pricing
uncertainty_notes: The 700bps tradability threshold is far above any plausible 12h move in these liquid proxies, so neither prediction is 'tradable' by that bar
Direction of dollar is genuinely ambiguous under a crisis-easing scenario (haven bid vs rate-differential softening)
Prediction-market probability shifts on far-tail policy paths are noisy and thinly traded
The 'military_conflict' topic tag is inconsistent with a Fed-rate question, reducing confidence in the market's clean interpretation

llm_justification.summary: A market on 7 Fed rate cuts in 2026 encodes an extreme dovish/emergency-easing path. A sharp rise in that probability would most cleanly imply lower expected policy rates, favoring long Treasuries (TLT up) and, more ambiguously, a softer dollar (UUP down). Magnitudes over 12h are small relative to the 700bps threshold, so these are research signals, not tradable moves.
key_assumptions: A move in this market reflects genuine repricing of the Fed path rather than illiquid noise
Duration proxies respond primarily to rate-path expectations over the window
No dominant already-public macro catalyst fully explains the move
failure_modes: The dovish repricing may be driven by a public recession/crisis headline already in asset prices, so no leak edge exists
Crisis-driven easing can trigger safe-haven dollar strength, reversing the UUP call
Thin far-tail prediction market can move on tiny flows unrelated to fundamentals
12h moves in TLT/UUP will almost certainly fall far below the 700bps tradability bar, making both non-actionable
Long-end bonds may not rally if easing expectations coincide with inflation/term-premium concerns
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
